about: What scripts/check-claims.mjs checks in a cited transaction beyond its status, block, time and gas (those are read from the tables that cite it). Each entry is one claim the docs make, with the events its receipt must contain. Values: '10 USDG' and '369.86 USD' are exact amounts in the unit's decimals; a leading '~' compares after rounding to the decimals written ('~0.20 WAD'); '8 (DeltaOutOfBand)' is an enum value with its name; addresses compare case-insensitively. 'status': 'reverted' marks a transaction cited because it failed. 'context' lists figures a citing sentence may also state that are not in this receipt (balances before and after), each with what it is.
